items.text: David Matanga is the city treasurer of Montebello. He has worked as a senior tax compliance representative for the California Employment Development Department. He says he has more than 20 years of experience as a union activist with SEIU 1000 and the LA County Federation of Labor. He was elected treasurer in 2022.
